series3_actions.title: Actions run volume — reconstructed corpus (daily increments)
series3_actions.method: Delta of run_count/total_jobs between consecutive daily docs/ops/generated/actions-performance-reconstructed-*.json files (cumulative, label locally_reconstructed, source_count == run_count). minutes_est = jobs_delta × that day's avg_job_duration_ms / 60000 — an estimate. Corpus grows ~40 runs/day by reconstruction sampling: increments are corpus growth, NOT total fleet Actions volume.

spike.provenance: quota-specialist pack 2026-10-29 + cadence lane timeline 2026-10-29 (rate-limit record PR #2321/#2322, burst-fix record PR #2341, history-verified per cadence lane)
spike.outcome: burst-fix PR #2341 (merged 97938a583f50): retry ×4 (Retry-After / X-RateLimit-Reset, 120s cap) in both collectors + 15-min freshness gate on delphi-rfp-feed-collect workflow_run (loop breaker); 3 workflows re-enabled with green proof each
spike.detail: Each collect ran ~30–80 calls on the installation token (1000/hr bucket); mid-storm the reviewer map crossed 24h staleness, so every orchestrator completion launched a ~750-call reviewer-metrics collect on the OPERATOR (PAT user) token — the PAT-bucket burn mechanism.

annotations.text: PAT wall ↔ multi-lane polling in hot merge hours (quota pack: tier1 steward + viz + quota-convergence publish attempts active). Per-consumer attribution NOT ESTABLISHED — GitHub exposes none to a PAT (cadence lane). Lesson of record: poll sparingly, batch reads, head-SHA check-runs.
Fresh window: 42 core calls fleet-wide in 77s (~1900/h baseline pace before spikes) — cadence lane timeline, rate-limit record PR #2321/#2322.

Incident 2 (rate-limit lane record): the full 5000-call window burned in ~25 min (11:41:45Z–~12:06Z); the earlier ~1452-call figure was only the forwarding lane's 11:56Z–12:06Z segment. Per-consumer attribution NOT ESTABLISHED.

Feed-collect burst ↔ delphi-gate workflow_run storm: 143 runs / 25 min, each firing UNTHROTTLED delphi-rfp-feed-collect (~30–80 installation-token calls); reviewer map crossed 24h staleness mid-storm → orchestrator completions launched ~750-call reviewer-metrics collects on the PAT token. Fixed by PR #2341 (merged 97938a583f50): retry ×4 + 15-min freshness gate loop breaker; 3 workflows re-enabled green.
QAC-007 (PR #2323): pat_publish derived-reserve preflight enacted — publish defers when remaining < planned calls + limit/10, so lanes stop draining the shared bucket into walls.
Vercel cap-trip 2026-10-20 ↔ dashboard deploy bursts (tribute-vercel-prod promotions; registry notes API undercounts enforcement ≥13). OpenRouter free daily cap exhausted the same day.

Burn shape correction (convergence, verified from reset epochs): NO instant re-exhaustion — the new window opened at the 01:42:09Z reset and drained on a sustained ~120–160 calls/min ramp (4999 @01:43Z viz preflight → 4645 @~01:45Z → 3230 @~01:54Z, used 1770). A 5000 bucket dies in ~30–40 min of storm and stays dead until the hourly reset; graph walls as ramps, not spikes. Consistent with the quota lane's firsthand ~150/min, ~32-min burn on 2026-10-29.
